units.zh: 梁書卷第四十三 列傳第三十七
units.en: Book of Liang, Volume 43, Biography 37
units.literal: Book of Liang, Volume 43, Biography 37

units.zh: 韋粲 江子一 弟子四 子五 張嵊 沈浚 柳敬禮
units.en: Wei Can; Jiang Ziyi; his younger brothers Zisi and Ziwu; Zhang Sheng; Shen Jun; Liu Jingli
units.literal: Wei Can; Jiang Ziyi; younger brother Zisi; younger brother Ziwu; Zhang Sheng; Shen Jun; Liu Jingli

units.zh: 韋粲字長蒨，車騎將軍叡之孫，北徐州刺史放之子也。
units.en: Wei Can, styled Changqian, was grandson of Rapid Cavalry General Rui and son of North Xuzhou Inspector Fang.
units.literal: Wei Can, courtesy name Changqian, was grandson of Rapid Cavalry General Rui and son of North Xuzhou Inspector Fang.

units.zh: 有父風，好學仗氣，身長八尺，容貌甚偉。
units.en: He had his father's manner, loved learning and bore himself with spirit; eight chi tall, with a truly imposing presence.
units.literal: He had his father's manner, loved learning and bore himself with spirit; eight chi tall, his appearance was very imposing.

units.zh: 初爲雲麾晉安王行參軍，俄署法曹，遷外兵參軍，兼中兵。
units.en: He began as traveling aide on the staff of the Cloud-Banner Prince of Jin'an, soon held the law bureau, rose to exterior military aide, and concurrently interior military aide.
units.literal: He first served as traveling aide on the staff of the Cloud-Banner Prince of Jin'an, soon held the law bureau, was promoted to exterior military aide, and concurrently interior military aide.

units.zh: 時潁川庾仲容、吳郡張率，前輩知名，與粲同府，並忘年交好。
units.en: Yu Zhongrong of Yingchuan and Zhang Shuai of Wu, famed seniors, shared the same headquarters with Can and became close friends despite the gap in years.
units.literal: At the time Yu Zhongrong of Yingchuan and Zhang Shuai of Wu commandery, famed seniors of earlier standing, were in the same headquarters and became friends with Can despite the gap in years.

units.zh: 及王遷鎮雍州，隨轉記室，兼中兵如故。
units.en: When the prince moved to garrison Yongzhou, Can became secretariat aide and kept his concurrent interior military post.
units.literal: When the prince was transferred to garrison Yongzhou, Can moved with him to secretariat aide, still concurrently interior military aide as before.

units.zh: 王立爲皇太子，粲遷步兵校尉，入爲東宮領直，丁父憂去職。
units.en: When the prince became crown prince, Can rose to colonel of the infantry guard, entered as commander of the Eastern Palace guard, then left office to mourn his father.
units.literal: When the prince was established as crown prince, Can was promoted to colonel of the infantry guard, entered court as commander of the Eastern Palace guard, and left office for his father's mourning.

units.zh: 尋起爲招遠將軍，復爲領直。
units.en: Soon he was recalled as General Who Wins the Distant and again commander of the guard.
units.literal: Soon he was recalled as General Who Wins the Distant and again commander of the guard.

units.zh: 服闋，襲爵永昌縣侯，除安西湘東王諮議，累遷太子僕、左衛率，領直並如故。
units.en: When mourning ended he inherited the marquisate of Yongchang and became staff adviser to the Prince of Xiangdong of the Anxi Army, then rose through crown prince steward and left guard leader while keeping his guard command.
units.literal: When mourning ended he inherited the marquisate of Yongchang county and was made staff adviser to the Prince of Xiangdong of the Anxi Army, then rose through crown prince steward and left guard leader, keeping his guard command as before.

units.zh: 粲以舊恩，任寄綢密，雖居職屢徙，常留宿衛，頗擅威名，誕倨，不爲時輩所平。
units.en: Because of old favor Can was entrusted with intimate duties; though his posts shifted, he regularly remained on night guard, wielded real prestige, and was haughty—men of the day did not regard him as their equal.
units.literal: Because of old favor Can was entrusted with intimate duties; though his posts often changed, he regularly remained on night guard, wielded considerable reputation for awe, and was haughty and proud—men of the day did not regard him as their equal.

units.zh: 右衛朱异嘗於酒席厲色謂粲曰：「卿何得已作領軍面向人！」
units.en: Right Guard Zhu Yi once said to Can at a banquet in harsh tones, "How dare you already act like a commandant of the army before people!"
units.literal: Right Guard Zhu Yi once said to Can at a banquet in harsh tones: "How dare you already act like a commandant of the army before people!"

units.zh: 中大同十一年，遷通直散騎常侍，未拜，出爲持節、督衡州諸軍事、安遠將軍、衡州刺史。
units.en: In the eleventh year of Zhongdatong he was promoted to regular palace attendant for direct communication, did not take office, and went out as bearer of the staff, commander of Hengzhou military affairs, General of Peaceful Distance, and inspector of Hengzhou.
units.literal: In the eleventh year of Zhongdatong he was promoted to regular palace attendant for direct communication, did not take office, and went out as bearer of the staff, commander of military affairs in Hengzhou, General of Peaceful Distance, and inspector of Hengzhou.

units.zh: 皇太子出餞新亭，執粲手曰：「與卿不爲久別。」
units.en: The crown prince came out to Xinting to see him off and took his hand, saying, "With you it will not be a long parting."
units.literal: The crown prince came out to Xinting to see him off and took Can's hand, saying: "With you it will not be a long parting."

units.zh: 太清元年，粲至州無幾，便表解職。
units.en: In the first year of Supreme Purity Can had barely reached his post when he memorialized to resign.
units.literal: In the first year of Supreme Purity Can had been at his post only a short time when he memorialized to resign.

units.zh: 二年，徵爲散騎常侍。
units.en: In the second year he was summoned as regular palace attendant.
units.literal: In the second year he was summoned as regular palace attendant.

units.zh: 粲還至廬陵，聞侯景作逆，便簡閱部下，得精卒五千，馬百匹，倍道赴援。
units.en: Can returned as far as Luling, heard Hou Jing had rebelled, reviewed his men, gathered five thousand picked troops and a hundred horses, and hurried to the rescue by forced marches.
units.literal: Can returned as far as Luling, heard that Hou Jing had rebelled, reviewed his subordinates, got five thousand picked troops and a hundred horses, and hurried by forced marches to the rescue.

units.zh: 至豫章，奉命報云「賊已出橫江」，粲卽就內史劉孝儀共謀之。
units.en: Reaching Yuzhang he received orders reporting, "The bandits have already crossed Hengjiang," and at once went to interior minister Liu Xiaoyi to plan.
units.literal: Reaching Yuzhang he received orders reporting "the bandit has already crossed Hengjiang," and Can at once went to the interior minister Liu Xiaoyi to plan together.

units.zh: 孝儀曰：「必期如此，當有別敕。
units.en: Xiaoyi said, "If it must be so, there should be a separate edict.
units.literal: Xiaoyi said: "If it must be so, there should be a separate edict.

units.zh: 豈可輕信單使，妄相驚動，或恐不然。」
units.en: How can we lightly trust a lone messenger and rashly stir alarm—perhaps it is not so after all."
units.literal: How can we lightly trust a lone messenger and rashly stir alarm—perhaps it is not so after all."

units.zh: 時孝儀置酒，粲怒，以杯抵地曰：「賊已渡江，便逼宮闕，水陸俱斷，何暇有報；
units.en: Xiaoyi was setting out wine; Can in anger dashed his cup to the ground and said, "The bandit has crossed the river and presses on the palace gates; land and water are both cut—what leisure is there for reports;
units.literal: At the time Xiaoyi was setting out wine; Can in anger dashed his cup to the ground and said: "The bandit has crossed the river and presses on the palace gates; land and water routes are both cut—what leisure is there for reports;

units.zh: 假令無敕，豈得自安？
units.en: even if there were no edict, how could one rest at ease?
units.literal: even if there were no edict, how could one rest at ease?

units.zh: 韋粲今日何情飲酒！」
units.en: What heart has Wei Can today for drinking wine!"
units.literal: What heart has Wei Can today for drinking wine!"

units.zh: 卽馳馬出，部分將發，會江州刺史當陽公大心遣使要粲，粲乃馳往見大心曰：「上游蕃鎮，江州去京最近，殿下情計，實宜在前；
units.en: He galloped out and arrayed his forces to march, when the Duke of Dangyang, Daxin, governor of Jiangzhou, summoned him; Can galloped to Daxin and said, "The garrison towns upriver are the realm's bulwarks; Jiangzhou is nearest the capital—in intent Your Highness should go first;
units.literal: He at once galloped out, arrayed his forces to march, when the Duke of Dangyang, Daxin, governor of Jiangzhou, sent a messenger summoning Can; Can galloped to see Daxin and said: "The garrison towns upriver are the realm's bulwarks; Jiangzhou is nearest the capital—in intent Your Highness should surely go first;

units.zh: 但中流任重，當須應接，不可闕鎮。
units.en: but the midstream burden is weighty and must be met—one cannot leave the garrison vacant.
units.literal: but the midstream burden is weighty and must be met—one cannot leave the garrison vacant.

units.zh: 今直且張聲勢，移鎮湓城，遣偏將賜隨，於事便足。」
units.en: For now simply raise a great clamor and shift the garrison to Pencheng; send a subordinate general to follow—that will suffice."
units.literal: For now simply raise a great clamor and shift the garrison to Pencheng; send a subordinate general to follow—that will suffice for affairs."

units.zh: 大心然之，遣中兵柳昕帥兵二千人隨粲。
units.en: Daxin agreed and sent middle army officer Liu Xin with two thousand troops to follow Can.
units.literal: Daxin agreed and sent the middle army officer Liu Xin with two thousand troops to follow Can.

units.zh: 粲悉留家累於江州，以輕舸就路。
units.en: Can left all his family in Jiangzhou and took light boats on the road.
units.literal: Can left all his family dependents in Jiangzhou and took light boats on the road.

units.zh: 至南州，粲外弟司州刺史柳仲禮亦帥步騎萬餘人至橫江，粲卽送糧仗贍給之，並散私金帛以賞其戰士。
units.en: Reaching South Prefecture, his cousin by marriage, Sizhou inspector Liu Zhongli, also led more than ten thousand foot and horse to Hengjiang; Can sent grain and weapons to supply him and distributed private gold and silk to reward his warriors.
units.literal: Reaching South Prefecture, his cousin by marriage, Inspector of Sizhou Liu Zhongli, also led more than ten thousand foot and horse to Hengjiang; Can at once sent grain and weapons to supply him and distributed private gold and silk to reward his warriors.

units.zh: 先是，安北將軍鄱陽王範亦自合肥遣西豫州刺史裴之高與其長子嗣，帥江西之衆赴京師，屯於張公洲，待上流諸軍至。
units.en: Earlier Pacifying North General, the Prince of Poyang Fan, had from Hefei sent Western Yuzhou inspector Pei Zhigao with his eldest son Si, leading Jiangxi forces toward the capital, encamped at Zhanggong Isle, waiting for upriver armies.
units.literal: Earlier the Pacifying North General, the Prince of Poyang Fan, had also from Hefei sent Western Yuzhou Inspector Pei Zhigao with his eldest son Si, leading the Jiangxi forces toward the capital, encamped at Zhanggong Isle, waiting for the upriver armies to arrive.

units.zh: 是時，之高遣船渡仲禮，與合軍進屯王游苑。
units.en: Zhigao sent boats to ferry Zhongli; they united and advanced to encamp at Wang You Park.
units.literal: At that time Zhigao sent boats to ferry Zhongli; they united and advanced to encamp at Wang You Park.

units.zh: 粲建議推仲禮爲大都督，報下流衆軍。
units.en: Can proposed making Zhongli grand commander and reported this to the downstream armies.
units.literal: Can proposed making Zhongli grand commander and reporting this to the downstream armies.

units.zh: 裴之高自以年位恥居其下，乃云：「柳節下是州將，何須我復鞭板？」
units.en: Pei Zhigao, ashamed to stand below him in age and rank, said, "Master Liu the prefect is a provincial commander—why need I again wield the whip and board?"
units.literal: Pei Zhigao, ashamed to stand below him in age and rank, said: "Master Liu the prefect is a provincial commander—why need I again wield the whip and board?"

units.zh: 累日不決。
units.en: For days no decision was reached.
units.literal: For days no decision was reached.

units.zh: 粲乃抗言於衆曰：「今者同赴國難，義在除賊，所以推柳司州者，政以久捍邊疆，先爲侯景所憚；
units.en: Can then spoke firmly before the assembly, "Today we share the state's peril; righteousness lies in destroying the bandit—therefore we propose Liu the Sizhou inspector, because he has long defended the frontier and Hou Jing fears him first;
units.literal: Can then spoke firmly before the assembly: "Today we share in the state's peril; righteousness lies in destroying the bandit—therefore we propose Liu the inspector of Sizhou, because he has long defended the frontier and Hou Jing fears him first;

units.zh: 且士馬精銳，無出其前。
units.en: moreover his troops and horses are elite, none surpass him.
units.literal: moreover his troops and horses are elite, none surpass him.

units.zh: 若論位次，柳在粲下；
units.en: If we speak of rank, Liu stands below Can;
units.literal: If we speak of rank, Liu stands below Can;

units.zh: 語其年齒，亦少於粲，直以社稷之計，不得復論。
units.en: if we speak of years, he is younger than Can too—only for the altars' sake we cannot argue further.
units.literal: if we speak of years, he is younger than Can too—only for the altars' sake we cannot argue further.

units.zh: 今日形勢，貴在將和；
units.en: Today's situation values generals in harmony;
units.literal: Today's situation values generals in harmony;

units.zh: 若人心不同，大事去矣。
units.en: if hearts differ, the great affair is lost.
units.literal: if hearts differ, the great affair is lost.

units.zh: 裴公朝之舊齒，年德已隆，豈應復挾私情，以沮大計。
units.en: Lord Pei is a court elder in age and virtue—surely he should not indulge private feeling and thwart the great plan.
units.literal: Lord Pei is an elder of the court in age and virtue—surely he should not again indulge private feeling and thwart the great plan.

units.zh: 粲請爲諸君解釋之。」
units.en: Can asks to explain this for you all."
units.literal: Can asks to explain this for you all."

units.zh: 乃單舸至之高營，切讓之曰：「前諸將之議，豫州意所未同，卽二宮危逼，猾寇滔天，臣子當戮力同心，豈可自相矛盾！
units.en: He took a lone boat to Zhigao's camp and reproached him sharply, "The generals' councils did not accord with Lord Yuzhou's intent—yet the two palaces are in peril and the cunning bandit floods heaven; ministers should join strength—how can we contradict one another!
units.literal: He took a lone boat to Zhigao's camp and reproached him sharply: "The earlier councils of the generals did not accord with Lord Yuzhou's intent—yet the two palaces are in peril and the cunning bandit floods heaven; ministers should join strength in one heart—how can we contradict one another!

units.zh: 豫州必欲立異，鋒鏑便有所歸。」
units.en: If Lord Yuzhou insists on standing apart, blades and arrows will have their target."
units.literal: If Lord Yuzhou insists on standing apart, blades and arrows will have their target."

units.zh: 之高垂泣曰：「吾荷國恩榮，自應帥先士卒，顧恨衰老，不能效命，企望柳使君共平凶逆，謂衆議已從，無俟老夫耳。
units.en: Zhigao wept and said, "I have received the state's grace and should lead the van; I regret my old age and cannot devote my life, and hoped to look to Master Liu to pacify the villain together—I thought the assembly had agreed and had no need of this old man.
units.literal: Zhigao wept and said: "I have received the state's grace and glory and should myself lead the van; I regret my old age and cannot devote my life, and hoped to look to Master Liu the inspector to pacify the villain together—I thought the assembly had already agreed and had no need of this old man.

units.zh: 若必有疑，當剖心相示。」
units.en: If there must be doubt, I will lay open my heart."
units.literal: If there must be doubt, I will lay open my heart."

units.zh: 於是諸將定議，仲禮方得進軍。
units.en: Then the generals fixed their plan and Zhongli was able to advance.
units.literal: Then the generals fixed their plan and Zhongli was able to advance the army.

units.zh: 次新亭，賊列陣於中興寺，相持至晚，各解歸。
units.en: Stopping at Xinting, the bandit drew up lines at Zhongxing Temple; they faced each other until evening, each withdrawing.
units.literal: Stopping at Xinting, the bandit drew up battle lines at Zhongxing Temple; they faced each other until evening, each withdrawing.

units.zh: 是夜，仲禮入粲營，部分衆軍，旦日將戰，諸將各有據守，令粲頓青塘。
units.en: That night Zhongli entered Can's camp and arrayed the armies; at dawn they would fight; each general had his post, and Can was ordered to hold Qingtang.
units.literal: That night Zhongli entered Can's camp and arrayed the armies; at dawn they would fight; each general had his post, and Can was ordered to hold Qingtang.

units.zh: 青塘當石頭中路，粲慮柵壘未立，賊必爭之，頗以爲憚，謂仲禮曰：「下官才非禦侮，直欲以身殉國。
units.en: Qingtang lay on the middle road to Stone City; Can feared the palisade was not yet built and the bandit would contest it, and said to Zhongli, "My talent is not for repelling insults—I only wish to give my body for the state.
units.literal: Qingtang lay on the middle road to Stone City; Can feared the palisade was not yet built and the bandit would surely contest it, and was much afraid, saying to Zhongli: "This subordinate's talent is not for repelling insults—I only wish to give my body for the state.

units.zh: 節下善量其宜，不可致有虧喪。」
units.en: Master, weigh what is fit—do not let there be loss and ruin."
units.literal: Master, weigh what is fit—do not let there be loss and ruin."

units.zh: 仲禮曰：「青塘立柵，迫近淮渚，欲以糧儲船乘盡就泊之，此是大事，非兄不可。
units.en: Zhongli said, "To build a palisade at Qingtang close to the Huai ford is to bring grain stores and boats all to moor there—this is a great matter and cannot be done without you, brother.
units.literal: Zhongli said: "To build a palisade at Qingtang close to the Huai ford is to bring grain stores and boats all to moor there—this is a great matter and cannot be done without you, brother.

units.zh: 若疑兵少，當更差軍相助。」
units.en: If you fear too few troops, more troops can be sent to help."
units.literal: If you fear too few troops, more troops can be sent to help."

units.zh: 乃使直閤將軍劉叔胤師助粲，帥所部水陸俱進。
units.en: He sent direct-gate general Liu Shuyin to assist Can, leading his command by land and water together.
units.literal: He then sent the direct-gate general Liu Shuyin to assist Can, leading his command by land and water together.

units.zh: 時值昏霧，軍人迷失道，比及青塘，夜已過半，壘柵至曉未合。
units.en: Fog and dusk fell; the soldiers lost the road, and by the time they reached Qingtang it was past midnight; the palisade was not closed by dawn.
units.literal: At the time fog and dusk fell; the soldiers lost the road, and by the time they reached Qingtang it was past midnight; the palisade was not closed by dawn.

units.zh: 景登禪靈寺門閣，望粲營未立，便率銳卒來攻。
units.en: Jing climbed the gate-tower of Chanling Temple, saw Can's camp not yet established, and led crack troops to attack.
units.literal: Jing climbed the gate-tower of Chanling Temple, saw Can's camp not yet established, and led crack troops to attack.

units.zh: 軍副王長茂勸據柵待之，粲不從，令軍主鄭逸逆擊之，命劉叔胤以水軍截其後。
units.en: Deputy Wang Changmao urged holding the palisade and waiting; Can would not agree and ordered commander Zheng Yi to meet the attack, commanding Liu Shuyin with the water army to cut the rear.
units.literal: The deputy Wang Changmao urged holding the palisade and waiting; Can would not agree and ordered the commander Zheng Yi to meet the attack, commanding Liu Shuyin with the water army to cut off the rear.

units.zh: 叔胤畏懦不敢進，逸遂敗。
units.en: Shuyin in cowardice dared not advance; Yi was defeated.
units.literal: Shuyin in cowardice dared not advance; Yi was defeated.

units.zh: 賊乘勝入營，左右牽粲避賊，粲不動，猶叱子弟力戰，兵死略盡，遂見害，時年五十四。
units.en: The bandit pressed the victory into the camp; attendants pulled Can away but he did not move, still shouting at his sons and brothers to fight hard; soldiers died almost to the last man, and he was killed at fifty-four.
units.literal: The bandit pressed the victory into the camp; attendants pulled Can away from the bandit but he did not move, still shouting at his sons and younger brothers to fight hard; soldiers died almost to the last man, and he was killed at age fifty-four.

units.zh: 粲子尼及三弟助、警、構、從弟昂皆戰死，親戚死者數百人。
units.en: Can's son Ni and three younger brothers Zhu, Jing, and Gou, and cousin Ang, all died in battle; kin who died numbered in the hundreds.
units.literal: Can's son Ni and three younger brothers Zhu, Jing, and Gou, and cousin Ang, all died in battle; kin who died numbered in the hundreds.

units.zh: 賊傳粲首闕下，以示城內，太宗聞之流涕曰：「社稷所寄，惟在韋公，如何不幸，先死行陣。」
units.en: The bandit displayed Can's head below the gate; when the Heir Apparent heard he wept and said, "The altars' trust rested only in Lord Wei—how could he die first in the ranks."
units.literal: The bandit displayed Can's head below the gate to show the city; when the Heir Apparent heard he wept and said: "The altars' trust rested only in Lord Wei—how could he, unhappily, die first in the ranks."

units.zh: 詔贈護軍將軍。
units.en: An edict posthumously made him General Who Guards the Army.
units.literal: An edict posthumously made him General Who Guards the Army.

units.zh: 世祖平侯景，追諡曰忠貞，並追贈助、警、構及尼皆中書郎，昂員外散騎常侍。
units.en: When Emperor Shizu pacified Hou Jing, he was posthumously titled Loyal and Upright, and Zhu, Jing, Gou, and Ni were posthumously made Secretariat gentlemen, Ang exterior regular palace attendant.
units.literal: When the Shizu Emperor pacified Hou Jing, he was posthumously titled Loyal and Upright, and Zhu, Jing, Gou, and Ni were all posthumously made gentlemen of the Secretariat, Ang exterior regular palace attendant.

units.zh: 粲長子臧，字君理。
units.en: Can's eldest son Zang, styled Junli.
units.literal: Can's eldest son Zang, styled Junli.

units.zh: 歷官尚書三公郎、太子洗馬、東宮領直。
units.en: He held posts as gentleman in the three excellencies bureau, crown prince steward, and commander of the Eastern Palace guard.
units.literal: He held posts as gentleman in the three excellencies bureau, crown prince steward, and commander of the Eastern Palace guard.

units.zh: 侯景至，帥兵屯西華門。
units.en: When Hou Jing arrived he led troops to garrison the Western Splendid Gate.
units.literal: When Hou Jing arrived he led troops to garrison the Western Splendid Gate.

units.zh: 城陷，奔江州，收舊部曲，據豫章，爲其部下所害。
units.en: When the city fell he fled to Jiangzhou, gathered his old command, held Yuzhang, and was killed by his subordinates.
units.literal: When the city fell he fled to Jiangzhou, gathered his old command, held Yuzhang, and was killed by his subordinates.

units.zh: 江子一字元貞，濟陽考城人，晉散騎常侍統之七世孫也。
units.en: Jiang Ziyi, styled Yuanchen, came from Kaocheng in Jiyang, seventh-generation descendant of Jin's regular palace attendant Tong.
units.literal: Jiang Ziyi, styled Yuanchen, was a native of Kaocheng in Jiyang, seventh-generation descendant of Regular Palace Attendant Tong under Jin.

units.zh: 父法成，天監中奉朝請。
units.en: His father Facheng had been a court gentleman in attendance under Heavenly Surveillance.
units.literal: His father Facheng had been a court gentleman in attendance under Heavenly Surveillance.

units.zh: 子一少好學，有志操，以家貧闕養，因蔬食終身。
units.en: Ziyi from youth loved learning and had resolve; because his family was poor he ate vegetables all his life.
units.literal: Ziyi from youth loved learning and had resolve; because his family was poor and could not support him, he ate vegetables all his life.

units.zh: 起家王國侍郎、朝請。
units.en: He began as gentleman in a princely kingdom and court gentleman in attendance.
units.literal: He began office as gentleman in a princely kingdom and court gentleman in attendance.

units.zh: 啓求觀書秘閣，高祖許之，有敕直華林省。
units.en: He memorialized to view books in the secret archive; the Founding Emperor granted it and ordered him to attend directly at the Orchard of Splendor.
units.literal: He memorialized asking to view books in the secret archive; the Founding Emperor granted it and issued an edict that he attend directly at the Orchard of Splendor.

units.zh: 其姑夫右衛將軍朱异，權要當朝，休下之日，賓客輻湊，子一未嘗造門，其高潔如此。
units.en: His uncle by marriage, Right Guard Zhu Yi, held power; on days off guests crowded in—but Ziyi never came to his gate; such was his lofty purity.
units.literal: His uncle by marriage, Right Guard General Zhu Yi, held power in his day; on his days off guests crowded in—but Ziyi never once came to his gate; such was his lofty purity.

units.zh: 稍遷尚書儀曹郎，出爲遂昌、曲阿令，皆著美績。
units.en: He rose to gentleman in the ritual bureau, went out as magistrate of Suichang and Qu'a, and in both showed fine achievement.
units.literal: He was gradually promoted to gentleman in the ritual bureau of the Secretariat, went out as magistrate of Suichang and Qu'a, and in both showed fine achievement.

units.zh: 除通直散騎侍郎，出爲戎昭將軍、南津校尉。
units.en: He was made regular palace attendant for direct communication, went out as General of Martial Proclamation and colonel of the southern ford.
units.literal: He was made regular palace attendant for direct communication, went out as General of Martial Proclamation and colonel of the southern ford.

units.zh: 弟子四，歷尚書金部郎。
units.en: His younger brother Zisi had held gentleman in the treasury bureau of gold.
units.literal: His younger brother Zisi had held the post of gentleman in the treasury bureau of gold.

units.zh: 大同初，遷右丞。
units.en: At the opening of Great Unity he was promoted to right assistant.
units.literal: At the opening of Great Unity he was promoted to right assistant.

units.zh: 兄弟性並剛烈。
units.en: The brothers were all fierce by nature.
units.literal: The brothers were all fierce by nature.

units.zh: 子四自右丞上封事，極言得失，高祖甚善之，詔尚書詳擇施行焉。
units.en: From his post as right assistant Zisi submitted a memorial on gains and losses; the Founding Emperor greatly approved and ordered the Secretariat to examine and carry out what was fit.
units.literal: From his post as right assistant Zisi submitted a memorial stating gains and losses to the full; the Founding Emperor greatly approved and ordered the Secretariat to examine and carry out what was fit.

units.zh: 左民郎沈炯、少府丞顧璵嘗奏事不允，高祖厲色呵責之；
units.en: Left People Gentleman Shen Jiong and junior palace supplies aide Gu Yu once memorialized without approval; the Founding Emperor shouted and rebuked them in anger;
units.literal: Left People Gentleman Shen Jiong and junior palace supplies aide Gu Yu once memorialized on affairs without approval; the Founding Emperor in anger shouted and rebuked them;

units.zh: 子四乃趨前代炯等對，言甚激切，高祖怒呼縛之，子四據地不受，高祖怒亦止，乃釋之。
units.en: Zisi hurried forward to answer for Jiong and the rest in fierce words; the Founding Emperor ordered him bound; Zisi sat on the ground and would not submit; the emperor's anger ceased and he released him.
units.literal: Zisi then hurried forward to answer for Jiong and the rest in words very fierce; the Founding Emperor in rage ordered him bound; Zisi sat on the ground and would not submit; the Founding Emperor's anger also ceased, and he released him.

units.zh: 猶坐免職。
units.en: He was still demoted and removed from office.
units.literal: He was still demoted and removed from office.

units.zh: 及侯景反，攻陷歷陽，自橫江將渡，子一帥舟師千餘人，於下流欲邀之，其副董桃生家在江北，因與其黨散走。
units.en: When Hou Jing rebelled and took Liyang and was about to cross from Hengjiang, Ziyi led more than a thousand boats downstream to intercept him, but deputy Dong Taosheng had family north of the river and fled with his faction.
units.literal: When Hou Jing rebelled and took Liyang, he was about to cross from Hengjiang; Ziyi led more than a thousand boats downstream intending to intercept him, but his deputy Dong Taosheng had family north of the river and with his faction scattered and fled.

units.zh: 子一乃退還南洲，復收餘衆，步道赴京師。
units.en: Ziyi withdrew to South Isle, gathered the remainder again, and went on foot toward the capital.
units.literal: Ziyi then withdrew to South Isle, gathered the remainder again, and went on foot toward the capital.

units.zh: 賊亦尋至，子一啓太宗曰：「賊圍未合，猶可出蕩，若營柵一固，無所用武。」
units.en: The bandit soon arrived; Ziyi memorialized the Heir Apparent, "The siege is not yet closed—one can still sally out; once camps are fixed, arms are useless."
units.literal: The bandit also soon arrived; Ziyi memorialized the Heir Apparent: "The bandit siege is not yet closed—one can still sally out; once camps are fixed, there is no use for arms."

units.zh: 請與其弟子四、子五帥所領百餘人，開承明門挑賊。
units.en: He asked with his younger brothers Zisi and Ziwu to lead more than a hundred men to open the Chengming Gate and challenge the bandit.
units.literal: He asked with his younger brothers Zisi and Ziwu to lead their command of more than a hundred men to open the Chengming Gate and challenge the bandit.

units.zh: 許之。
units.en: Permission was granted.
units.literal: Permission was granted.

units.zh: 子一乃身先士卒，抽戈獨進，群賊夾攻之，從者莫敢繼。
units.en: Ziyi took the lead, drew his halberd and advanced alone; bandits attacked from both sides and followers dared not follow.
units.literal: Ziyi then took the lead before the soldiers, drew his halberd and advanced alone; bandits attacked from both sides and followers dared not follow.

units.zh: 子四、子五見事急，相引赴賊，並見害。
units.en: Zisi and Ziwu, seeing affairs urgent, pulled one another toward the bandit and were both killed.
units.literal: Zisi and Ziwu, seeing affairs urgent, pulled one another toward the bandit and were both killed.

units.zh: 詔曰：「故戎昭將軍、通直散騎侍郎、南津校尉江子一，前尚書右丞江子四，東宮直殿主帥子五，禍故有聞，良以矜惻，死事加等，抑惟舊章。
units.en: An edict said, "The late General of Martial Proclamation, regular palace attendant, and colonel of the southern ford Jiang Ziyi; the late right assistant Jiang Zisi; and Eastern Palace direct-hall commander Ziwu—misfortune has brought report and we are deeply moved; to die for the affair merits higher rank by old regulations.
units.literal: An edict said: "The late General of Martial Proclamation, regular palace attendant for direct communication, and colonel of the southern ford Jiang Ziyi; the late right assistant Jiang Zisi; and the Eastern Palace direct-hall commander Ziwu—misfortune has brought report, and we are deeply moved; to die for the affair merits higher rank, as old regulations provide.

units.zh: 可贈子一給事黃門侍郎，子四中書侍郎，子五散騎侍郎。」
units.en: Ziyi may be posthumously made Yellow Gate gentleman; Zisi Secretariat gentleman; Ziwu regular palace attendant."
units.literal: Ziyi may be posthumously made gentleman in the Yellow Gate; Zisi gentleman in the Secretariat; Ziwu regular palace attendant."

units.zh: 侯景平，世祖又追贈子一侍中，諡義子；
units.en: When Hou Jing was pacified Emperor Shizu again posthumously made Ziyi palace attendant with the posthumous title Righteous;
units.literal: When Hou Jing was pacified the Shizu Emperor again posthumously made Ziyi palace attendant with the posthumous title Righteous;

units.zh: 子四黃門侍郎，諡毅子；
units.en: Zisi Yellow Gate gentleman with the posthumous title Resolute;
units.literal: Zisi gentleman in the Yellow Gate with the posthumous title Resolute;

units.zh: 子五中書侍郎，諡烈子。
units.en: Ziwu Secretariat gentleman with the posthumous title Fierce.
units.literal: Ziwu gentleman in the Secretariat with the posthumous title Fierce.

units.zh: 子一續《黃圖》及班固「九品」，並辭賦文筆數十篇，行於世。
units.en: Ziyi continued the Yellow Chart and Ban Gu's "Nine Ranks," and several tens of rhapsodies and prose pieces, which circulated in the world.
units.literal: Ziyi continued the Yellow Chart and Ban Gu's "Nine Ranks," and several tens of pieces of rhapsody and prose, which circulated in the world.

units.zh: 張嵊字四山，鎮北將軍稷之子也。
units.en: Zhang Sheng, styled Sishan, was son of Pacifying North General Ji.
units.literal: Zhang Sheng, courtesy name Sishan, was son of Pacifying North General Ji.

units.zh: 少方雅，有志操，能清言。
units.en: From youth he was upright and elegant, had resolve, and could speak with clarity.
units.literal: From youth he was upright and elegant, had resolve, and could speak with clarity.

units.zh: 父臨青州，爲土民所害，嵊感家禍，終身蔬食布衣，手不執刀刃。
units.en: His father while inspecting Qing province was killed by locals; Sheng, moved by the family calamity, ate vegetables and wore cloth all his life and never held a blade.
units.literal: His father while inspecting Qing province was killed by the local people; Sheng, moved by the family calamity, ate vegetables and wore cloth all his life and never held a blade in his hand.

units.zh: 州舉秀才。
units.en: The province nominated him as Presented Scholar.
units.literal: The province nominated him as Presented Scholar.

units.zh: 起家秘書郎，累遷太子舍人、洗馬、司徒左西掾、中書郎。
units.en: He began as secretary gentleman and rose through crown prince attendant, steward, left merit officer on the Minister of Education's staff, and Secretariat gentleman.
units.literal: He began office as secretary gentleman and rose through crown prince attendant, steward, left merit officer on the Minister of Education's staff, and gentleman of the Secretariat.

units.zh: 出爲永陽內史，還除中軍宣城王司馬、散騎常侍。
units.en: He went out as interior minister of Yongyang, returned as staff major to the Prince of Xuancheng of the Central Army and regular palace attendant.
units.literal: He went out as interior minister of Yongyang, returned and was made staff major to the Prince of Xuancheng of the Central Army and regular palace attendant.

units.zh: 又出爲鎮南湘東王長史、尋陽太守。
units.en: Again he went out as chief clerk to the Prince of Xiangdong of the Pacifying South Army and magistrate of Xunyang.
units.literal: Again he went out as chief clerk to the Prince of Xiangdong of the Pacifying South Army and magistrate of Xunyang.

units.zh: 中大同元年，徵爲太府卿，俄遷吳興太守。
units.en: In the first year of Zhongdatong he was summoned as minister of the palace treasury, soon promoted to magistrate of Wuxing.
units.literal: In the first year of Zhongdatong he was summoned as minister of the palace treasury, soon promoted to magistrate of Wuxing.

units.zh: 太清二年，侯景圍京城，嵊遣弟伊率郡兵數千人赴援。
units.en: In the second year of Supreme Purity Hou Jing besieged the capital; Sheng sent his younger brother Yi to lead several thousand commandery troops to the rescue.
units.literal: In the second year of Supreme Purity Hou Jing besieged the capital; Sheng sent his younger brother Yi to lead several thousand commandery troops to the rescue.

units.zh: 三年，宮城陷，御史中丞沈浚違難東歸。
units.en: In the third year the palace city fell; censor-in-chief Shen Jun fled east in hardship.
units.literal: In the third year the palace city fell; censor-in-chief Shen Jun fled east in hardship.

units.zh: 嵊往見而謂曰：「賊臣憑陵，社稷危恥，正是人臣效命之秋。
units.en: Sheng went to see him and said, "The traitor towers over us; the altars are in peril—this is the season for ministers to devote their lives.
units.literal: Sheng went to see him and said: "The traitor minister towers over us; the altars are in peril and shame—this is the season for ministers to devote their lives.

units.zh: 今欲收集兵力，保據貴鄉。
units.en: Now I wish to gather troops and hold your noble district.
units.literal: Now I wish to gather troops and hold your noble district.

units.zh: 若天道無靈，忠節不展，雖復及死，誠亦無恨。」
units.en: If Heaven is without spirit and loyal resolve cannot unfold, even if death follows, I have no regret."
units.literal: If Heaven's way is without spirit and loyal resolve cannot unfold, even if death follows, truly I have no regret."

units.zh: 浚曰：「鄙郡雖小，仗義拒逆，誰敢不從！」
units.en: Jun said, "Though my commandery is small, who relying on righteousness to resist the villain dares not follow!"
units.literal: Jun said: "Though my commandery is small, who relying on righteousness to resist the villain dares not follow!"

units.zh: 固勸嵊舉義。
units.en: He firmly urged Sheng to raise righteousness.
units.literal: He firmly urged Sheng to raise righteousness.

units.zh: 於是收集士卒，繕築城壘。
units.en: Thereupon he gathered soldiers and repaired walls and ramparts.
units.literal: Thereupon he gathered soldiers and repaired walls and ramparts.

units.zh: 時邵陵王東奔至錢唐，聞之，遣板授嵊征東將軍，加秩中二千石。
units.en: The Prince of Shaoling had fled east to Qiantang; hearing of it he sent a commission appointing Sheng General Who Pacifies the East with rank equal to two thousand shi.
units.literal: At the time the Prince of Shaoling had fled east to Qiantang; hearing of it he sent a commission appointing Sheng General Who Pacifies the East with rank equal to two thousand shi.

units.zh: 嵊曰：「朝廷危迫，天子蒙塵，今日何情，復受榮號。」
units.en: Sheng said, "The court is in peril and the Son of Heaven suffers dust—what heart today for glory and title."
units.literal: Sheng said: "The court is in peril and the Son of Heaven suffers dust—what heart today for receiving glory and title."

units.zh: 留板而已。
units.en: He kept the commission only.
units.literal: He kept the commission only.

units.zh: 賊行台劉神茂攻破義興，遣使說嵊曰：「若早降附，當還以郡相處，復加爵賞。」
units.en: The bandit field headquarters Liu Shenmao took Yixing and sent a messenger persuading Sheng, "If you surrender early, you will be returned the commandery to govern and receive enfeoffment and reward."
units.literal: The bandit's field headquarters Liu Shenmao took Yixing and sent a messenger persuading Sheng: "If you surrender early, you will be returned the commandery to govern and further receive enfeoffment and reward."

units.zh: 嵊命斬其使，仍遣軍主王雄等帥兵於鱧瀆逆擊之，破神茂，神茂退走。
units.en: Sheng ordered the messenger beheaded and sent commander Wang Xiong and others to meet the attack at Lüdu, defeated Shenmao, and Shenmao retreated.
units.literal: Sheng ordered the messenger beheaded and sent the commander Wang Xiong and others with troops to meet the attack at Lüdu, defeated Shenmao, and Shenmao retreated.

units.zh: 侯景聞神茂敗，乃遣其中軍侯子鑒帥精兵二萬人，助神茂以擊嵊。
units.en: Hou Jing heard Shenmao was defeated and sent his central army Hou Zijian with twenty thousand crack troops to help Shenmao attack Sheng.
units.literal: Hou Jing heard Shenmao was defeated and sent his central army Hou Zijian with twenty thousand crack troops to help Shenmao attack Sheng.

units.zh: 嵊遣軍主范智朗出郡西拒戰，爲神茂所敗，退歸。
units.en: Sheng sent commander Fan Zhilang west of the commandery to meet battle, was defeated by Shenmao, and withdrew.
units.literal: Sheng sent the commander Fan Zhilang west of the commandery to meet battle, was defeated by Shenmao, and withdrew.

units.zh: 賊騎乘勝焚柵，柵內衆軍皆土崩。
units.en: The bandit cavalry pressed the victory and burned the palisade; troops within the palisade all collapsed.
units.literal: The bandit cavalry pressed the victory and burned the palisade; troops within the palisade all collapsed.

units.zh: 嵊乃釋戎服，坐於聽事，賊臨之以刃，終不爲屈。
units.en: Sheng put off military dress and sat in the audience hall; the bandit held blades to him and he was never bent.
units.literal: Sheng then put off military dress and sat in the audience hall; the bandit held blades to him and he was never bent.

units.zh: 乃執嵊以送景，景刑之於都市，子弟同遇害者十餘人，時年六十二。
units.en: They seized Sheng and sent him to Jing; Jing executed him in the market, and sons and brothers who suffered with him numbered more than ten—he was sixty-two.
units.literal: They seized Sheng and sent him to Jing; Jing executed him in the market, and sons and younger brothers who suffered with him numbered more than ten—he was sixty-two.

units.zh: 賊平，世祖追贈侍中、中衛將軍、開府儀同三司。
units.en: When the bandit was pacified Emperor Shizu posthumously made him palace attendant, central army commander, and Grand Master with the Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon with the rites of the Three Excellencies.
units.literal: When the bandit was pacified the Shizu Emperor posthumously made him palace attendant, central army commander, and Grand Master with the Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon with the same rites as the Three Excellencies.

units.zh: 諡曰忠貞子。
units.en: His posthumous title was Loyal and Upright.
units.literal: His posthumous title was Loyal and Upright.

units.zh: 沈浚字叔源，吳興武康人。
units.en: Shen Jun, styled Shuyuan, came from Wukang in Wuxing.
units.literal: Shen Jun, courtesy name Shuyuan, was a native of Wukang in Wuxing.

units.zh: 祖憲，齊散騎常侍，齊史有傳。
units.en: His grandfather Xian had been regular palace attendant under Qi; the Qi history has his biography.
units.literal: His grandfather Xian had been regular palace attendant under Qi; the Qi history has his biography.

units.zh: 浚少博學，有才幹，歷山陰、吳、建康令，並有能名。
units.en: Jun from youth was broadly learned and gifted; he held Shanyin, Wu, and Jiankang in succession, all with a name for ability.
units.literal: Jun from youth was broadly learned and gifted in affairs; he held the magistracies of Shanyin, Wu, and Jiankang in succession, all with a name for ability.

units.zh: 入爲中書郎、尚書左丞。
units.en: He entered court as Secretariat gentleman and left assistant.
units.literal: He entered court as gentleman of the Secretariat and left assistant.

units.zh: 侯景逼京城，遷御史中丞。
units.en: When Hou Jing pressed the capital he was promoted to censor-in-chief.
units.literal: When Hou Jing pressed the capital he was promoted to censor-in-chief.

units.zh: 是時外援並至，侯景表請求和，詔許之。
units.en: Outside aid all arrived; Hou Jing memorialized asking for peace and an edict granted it.
units.literal: At that time outside aid all arrived; Hou Jing memorialized asking for peace and an edict granted it.

units.zh: 旣盟，景知城內疾疫，復懷奸計，遲疑不去。
units.en: After the oath Jing knew plague raged within the city and again harbored treacherous design, hesitating and not leaving.
units.literal: After the oath Jing knew plague raged within the city and again harbored treacherous design, hesitating and not leaving.

units.zh: 數日，皇太子令浚詣景所，景曰：「卽已向熱，非復行時。
units.en: After several days the crown prince ordered Jun to Jing's quarters; Jing said, "It has already turned hot—not the season for marching again.
units.literal: After several days the crown prince ordered Jun to Jing's quarters; Jing said: "It has already turned hot—not the season for marching again.

units.zh: 十萬之衆，何由可去，還欲立效朝廷，君可見爲申聞。」
units.en: A host of a hundred thousand—how could they go? I wish again to serve the court; you may report this for me."
units.literal: A host of a hundred thousand—how could they go? I wish again to render service to the court; you may report this for me."

units.zh: 浚曰：「將軍此論，意在得城。
units.en: Jun said, "General, this talk aims at getting the city.
units.literal: Jun said: "General, this talk of yours aims at getting the city.

units.zh: 城內兵糧，尚支百日。
units.en: Within the city troops and grain still last a hundred days.
units.literal: Within the city troops and grain still last a hundred days.

units.zh: 將軍儲積內盡，國家援軍外集，十萬之衆，將何所資？
units.en: General, your stores within are exhausted and rescue armies gather without—a host of a hundred thousand, on what will they rely?
units.literal: General, your stores within are exhausted and the state's rescue armies gather without—a host of a hundred thousand, on what will they rely?

units.zh: 而反設此言，欲脅朝廷邪？」
units.en: Yet you set forth this talk—do you mean to coerce the court?"
units.literal: Yet you set forth this talk—do you mean to coerce the court?"

units.zh: 景橫刃於膝，暿真目叱之。
units.en: Jing laid a blade across his knee, glared angrily, and shouted at him.
units.literal: Jing laid a blade across his knee and glared angrily and shouted at him.

units.zh: 浚正色責景曰：「明公親是人臣，舉兵向闕，聖主申恩赦過，已共結盟，口血未乾，而有翻背。
units.en: Jun in stern color rebuked Jing, "Your Grace is plainly a minister who raised troops against the palace; the sage ruler pardoned past faults and you have sworn alliance—oath blood not yet dry, yet there is treachery.
units.literal: Jun in stern color rebuked Jing: "Your Grace is plainly a minister who raised troops against the palace; the sage ruler extended grace and pardoned past faults, and you have already sworn alliance—oath blood not yet dry, yet there is treachery.

units.zh: 沈浚六十之年，且天子之使，死生有命，豈畏逆臣之刀乎！」
units.en: Shen Jun is sixty and the Son of Heaven's envoy—life and death have their allotment; how would I fear a traitor's blade!"
units.literal: Shen Jun is sixty years old and moreover the Son of Heaven's envoy—life and death have their allotment; how would I fear a traitor's blade!"

units.zh: 不顧而出。
units.en: Without a glance he went out.
units.literal: Without a glance he went out.

units.zh: 景曰：「是真司直也。」
units.en: Jing said, "This is a true upright censor."
units.literal: Jing said: "This is a true upright censor."

units.zh: 然密銜之。
units.en: Yet he secretly harbored resentment.
units.literal: Yet he secretly harbored resentment.

units.zh: 及破張嵊，乃求浚以害之。
units.en: When Zhang Sheng was defeated he asked for Jun to kill him.
units.literal: When Zhang Sheng was defeated he asked for Jun to kill him.

units.zh: 柳敬禮，開府儀同三司慶遠之孫。
units.en: Liu Jingli was grandson of Grand Master Qingyuan with the rites of the Three Excellencies.
units.literal: Liu Jingli was grandson of Grand Master with the Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon with the same rites as the Three Excellencies Qingyuan.

units.zh: 父津，太子詹事。
units.en: His father Jin was tutor to the crown prince.
units.literal: His father Jin was tutor to the crown prince.

units.zh: 敬禮與兄仲禮，皆少以勇烈知名。
units.en: Jingli and his elder brother Zhongli were both famed from youth for fierce courage.
units.literal: Jingli and his elder brother Zhongli were both famed from youth for fierce courage.

units.zh: 起家著作佐郎，稍遷扶風太守。
units.en: He began as gentleman of the Palace Library and rose to magistrate of Fufeng.
units.literal: He began office as gentleman of the Palace Library and was gradually promoted to magistrate of Fufeng.

units.zh: 侯景渡江，敬禮率馬步三千赴援。
units.en: When Hou Jing crossed the river Jingli led three thousand horse and foot to the rescue.
units.literal: When Hou Jing crossed the river Jingli led three thousand horse and foot to the rescue.

units.zh: 至都，據青溪埭，與景頻戰，恒先登陷陳，甚著威名。
units.en: Reaching the capital he held Qingxi Ford and fought Jing repeatedly, always first to scale and break the line, winning great renown.
units.literal: Reaching the capital he held Qingxi Ford and fought Jing repeatedly, always first to scale and break the line, winning great renown for martial awe.

units.zh: 台城沒，敬禮與仲禮俱見於景，景遣仲禮經略上流，留敬禮爲質，以爲護軍。
units.en: When the terrace city fell Jingli and Zhongli both appeared before Jing; Jing sent Zhongli upriver and kept Jingli as hostage, making him General Who Guards the Army.
units.literal: When the terrace city fell Jingli and Zhongli both appeared before Jing; Jing sent Zhongli to command the upriver region and kept Jingli as hostage, making him General Who Guards the Army.

units.zh: 景餞仲禮於後渚，敬禮密謂仲禮曰：「景今來會，敬禮抱之，兄拔佩刀，便可斫殺，敬禮死亦無所恨。」
units.en: Jing saw Zhongli off at Rear Ford; Jingli secretly said to Zhongli, "Jing comes to this meeting—Jingli will embrace him; brother, draw your sword and you can cut him down; Jingli dies without regret."
units.literal: Jing saw Zhongli off at Rear Ford; Jingli secretly said to Zhongli: "Jing comes to this meeting today—Jingli will embrace him; brother, draw your sword and you can cut him down; Jingli dies without regret."

units.zh: 仲禮壯其言，許之。
units.en: Zhongli admired his words and agreed.
units.literal: Zhongli admired his words and agreed.

units.zh: 及酒數行，敬禮目仲禮，仲禮見備衛嚴，不敢動，計遂不果。
units.en: When cups had gone round several times Jingli signaled Zhongli; Zhongli saw the guards strict and dared not move—the plan did not succeed.
units.literal: When cups had gone round several times Jingli signaled Zhongli; Zhongli saw the guards strict and dared not move—the plan in the end did not succeed.

units.zh: 會景征晉熙，敬禮與南康王會理共謀襲其城，剋期將發，建安侯蕭賁知而告之，遂遇害。
units.en: When Jing campaigned against Jinxing Jingli with the Prince of Nankang Huili plotted to seize his city; the day fixed they were about to rise when the Marquis of Jian'an Xiao Ben reported it, and he was killed.
units.literal: When Jing campaigned against Jinxing Jingli with the Prince of Nankang Huili plotted to seize his city; the day fixed they were about to rise when the Marquis of Jian'an Xiao Ben learned and reported it, and he was killed.

units.zh: 史臣曰：若夫義重於生，前典垂誥，斯蓋先哲之所貴也。
units.en: The historian writes: When righteousness outweighs life, former canons leave instruction—this is what the sages prized.
units.literal: The historian says: When righteousness outweighs life, former canons leave instruction—this is what the sages prized.

units.zh: 故孟子稱生者我所欲，義亦我所欲，二事必不可兼得，寧捨生而取義。
units.en: Thus Mencius said life is what I desire and righteousness is also what I desire; the two cannot be grasped together—I would rather relinquish life and take righteousness.
units.literal: Thus Mencius said life is what I desire and righteousness is also what I desire; the two cannot be grasped together—I would rather relinquish life and take righteousness.

units.zh: 至如張嵊二三子之徒，捐軀殉節，赴死如歸，英風勁氣，籠罩今古，君子知梁代之有忠臣焉。
units.en: Men such as Zhang Sheng and the two or three like him gave their bodies and died for integrity, going to death like returning home—their heroic wind and firm spirit cover past and present; the gentleman knows the Liang had loyal ministers.
units.literal: As for men such as Zhang Sheng and the two or three like him, who gave their bodies and died for integrity, going to death like returning home—their heroic wind and firm spirit cover past and present; the gentleman knows the Liang had loyal ministers.

units.zh: 沖母，梁武帝妹新安穆公主，卒於齊世，武帝以沖偏孤，深所鍾愛。
units.en: Chong's mother was Princess Xin'an Mu, a sister of Emperor Wu of Liang. She died in Qi times, and the emperor, seeing that Chong had been left partially orphaned, doted on him.
units.literal: Chong's mother was Princess Xin'an Mu, sister of Emperor Wu of Liang; she died in Qi times, and the Emperor, because Chong was a lone orphan, cherished him deeply.

units.zh: 按梁武帝即位後，追尊其父為文皇帝。
units.en: After Liang Wudi's accession he honored his father posthumously as Emperor Wen.
units.literal: According to the note, after Emperor Wu of Liang took the throne he posthumously honored his father as Emperor Wen.

units.zh: 王沖傳言其母為梁武帝妹新安穆公主，與此合。
units.en: Wang Chong's biography says his mother was Liang Wudi's sister Princess Xin'an Mu, which matches.
units.literal: The biography of Wang Chong says his mother was Emperor Wu of Liang's sister, Princess Xin'an Mu—this agrees.

units.zh: 王沖 王通弟勱 袁敬兄子樞
units.en: Wang Chong; Wang Tong, younger brother Mo; Yuan Jing, nephew Shu
units.literal: Wang Chong; Wang Tong, younger brother Mo; Yuan Jing, nephew Shu

units.zh: [2]琳，齊代娶梁武帝妹義興長公主，有子九人，嵭知名。
units.en: Lin, in Qi times, married Emperor Wu of Liang's sister, Princess of Yixing long; he had nine sons, all of whom won notice.
units.literal: Lin, in Qi times married Emperor Wu of Liang's sister Princess of Yixing long, had nine sons, and all became renowned.

units.zh: 大同末，梁武帝謁園陵，道出朱方，勱隨例迎候，队勱令從輦側，所經山川，莫不顧問，勱隨事應對，咸有故實。
units.en: Near the end of Datong, Emperor Wu of Liang visited the imperial tombs by way of Zhufang; Mo met him as custom required. The emperor ordered Mo to ride beside the carriage; at every hill and stream he asked questions, and Mo answered each with historical precedent.
units.literal: Near the end of Datong, Emperor Wu of Liang visited the imperial tombs; the route passed through Zhufang; Mo greeted him per custom; the Emperor ordered Mo to ride beside the carriage; every mountain and river passed, the Emperor inquired; Mo answered each matter with historical precedent.

units.zh: 及明崔甗之謗言，執侯景之奸使，昔人稱孟軻為勇，于文簡公見之。
units.en: When he exposed Cui Yan's slander and seized Hou Jing's treacherous envoy, one can see in Duke Wenjian the courage that earlier men praised in Meng Ke.
units.literal: When he exposed Cui Yan's slanderous words and seized Hou Jing's treacherous envoy, what men of old called Meng Ke's courage can be seen in Duke Wenjian.

units.zh: 㥄素與魏收不協，收既專典國史，㥄恐被惡言，乃悅之曰：「昔有班固，今則魏子。」
units.en: Ling had long been at odds with Wei Shou; once Shou came to monopolize the national history, Ling feared slander and flattered him, saying, "In old times there was Ban Gu; today there is Master Wei."
units.literal: Ling had long been at odds with Wei Shou; once Shou came to monopolize the national history, Ling feared slander and therefore flattered him, saying: "In old times there was Ban Gu; today there is Master Wei."

units.zh: 高祖詔景宗督衆軍援義之，豫州刺史韋叡亦預焉，而受景宗節度。
units.en: Gaozu ordered Jingzong to command the armies to relieve Yizhi; Yuzhou inspector Wei Rui joined as well, under Jingzong's command.
units.literal: Gaozu ordered Jingzong to command the massed armies to relieve Yizhi; Yuzhou Inspector Wei Rui also took part, but was placed under Jingzong's command.

units.zh: 令景宗與叡各攻一橋，叡攻其南，景宗攻其北。
units.en: He ordered Jingzong and Rui each to take one bridge—Rui the south, Jingzong the north.
units.literal: He ordered Jingzong and Rui each to attack one bridge—Rui the south, Jingzong the north.

units.zh: 叡遣所督將馮道根、李文釗、裴邃、韋寂等乘艦登岸，擊魏洲上軍盡殪。
units.en: Rui sent Feng Daogen, Li Wenzhao, Pei Sui, Wei Ji, and other generals under his command to land from the ships and slaughter the Wei troops on the isle.
units.literal: Rui sent the generals under his command—Feng Daogen, Li Wenzhao, Pei Sui, Wei Ji, and others—to board the warships, land, and annihilate the Wei troops on the isle.

units.zh: 及韋叡至，與景宗進頓邵陽洲，立壘去魏城百餘步。
units.en: When Wei Rui arrived, he and Jingzong advanced to Shaoyang Isle and built ramparts a little over a hundred paces from the Wei city.
units.literal: When Wei Rui arrived, he and Jingzong advanced and encamped at Shaoyang Isle, building ramparts within a hundred-odd paces of the Wei city.

units.zh: 惟韋叡年長，且州里勝流，特相敬重，同宴御筵，亦曲躬謙遜，高祖以此嘉之。
units.en: only Wei Rui, who was older and a leading man of their district, he specially honored; at imperial banquets he bowed with humble courtesy as well—Gaozu praised him for it.
units.literal: only Wei Rui was older and a leading figure of their native district, and he specially respected him; at banquets on the imperial mat he too bowed with humble courtesy—Gaozu praised him for this.

units.zh: 溉，〔一〕時梁州刺史陰子春、領軍朱异在焉。
units.en: Collation variant: (Gai), [1] At that time Liang inspector of Liangzhou Yin Zichun and director of the palace guard Zhu Yi were present.
units.literal: Collation variant: (Gai), At that time Liang Inspector of Liangzhou Yin Zichun and Director of the Palace Guard Zhu Yi were present.

units.zh: 子春素知申，即於坐所呼與為對，〔二〕申每有妙思，异觀而奇之，因引申遊處。
units.en: Zichun had long known Shen and immediately at the gathering called him to play a match, [2] Shen had fine conceptions each time; Yi watched and marveled, and thereafter drew Shen into his company.
units.literal: Zichun had long known Shen and immediately at the gathering called him to play a match, Shen had fine conceptions each time; Yi watched and marveled, and thereafter drew Shen into his company.

units.zh: 又命兗州刺史南康嗣王會理總馭群帥，指授方略。
units.en: He also ordered Yanzhou inspector Heir Prince of Nankang Hui Li to take overall command of the generals and set strategy.
units.literal: He also ordered Yanzhou inspector Heir Prince of Nankang Hui Li to command all commanders and assign strategy.

units.zh: 梁蕭繹為周軍所逼，遣使告急，且請援。
units.en: Xiao Yi of Liang, pressed by Zhou armies, sent envoys begging aid.
units.literal: Xiao Yi of Liang, pressed by Zhou armies, sent envoys reporting emergency and requesting aid.

units.zh: 冬，詔岳為西南道大行臺，統司徒潘相樂等救江陵。
units.en: In winter an edict made Yue grand field headquarters of the southwest circuit, commanding minister of state Pan Xiangyue and others to rescue Jiangling.
units.literal: In winter an edict made Yue Grand Field Headquarters of the Southwest Circuit, commanding Minister of State Pan Xiangyue and others to rescue Jiangling.

units.zh: 王亮 張稷 王瑩
units.en: Wang Liang; Zhang Ji; Wang Ying
units.literal: Wang Liang; Zhang Ji; Wang Ying

units.zh: 張稷字公喬，吳郡人也。
units.en: Zhang Ji, styled Gongqiao, was a man of Wu commandery.
units.literal: Zhang Ji, styled Gongqiao, was a native of Wu commandery.

units.zh: 張稷因機制變，亦其時也。
units.en: Zhang Ji seized the moment to shift course—that too was its time.
units.literal: Zhang Ji seized the moment to shift course—that too was its time.

units.zh: 高祖受禪，以功封江安縣侯，邑一千戶。
units.en: When Gaozu took the throne, Ji was enfeoffed as Marquis of Jiang'an for merit, with a fief of one thousand households.
units.literal: When Gaozu accepted the abdication, Ji was enfeoffed as Marquis of Jiang'an for his merit, with a fief of one thousand households.

units.zh: 時魏寇壽春，以稷爲寧朔將軍、軍主，副尚書僕射沈文季鎮豫州。
units.en: At the time Wei raided Shouchun; Ji was made pacifying-the-north general and army commander, assisting right vice director Shen Wenji in guarding Yuzhou.
units.literal: At the time Wei raided Shouchun; Ji was made Pacifying the North General and army commander, assisting Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Shen Wenji in guarding Yuzhou.

units.zh: 出爲使持節、散騎常侍、都督青、冀二州諸軍事、安北將軍、青、冀二州刺史。
units.en: He went out as bearer of credentials, cavalier attendant, area commander of Qing and Ji, Pacification North general, and inspector of Qing and Ji.
units.literal: He went out as Bearer of Credentials, Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary, Area Commander of Qing and Ji military affairs, Pacification North General, and Inspector of Qing and Ji provinces.

units.zh: 父永，宋右光祿大夫。
units.en: His father Yong was Song right grand master of splendid happiness.
units.literal: His father Yong was Song Right Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.

units.zh: 稷所生母遘疾歷時，稷始年十一，夜不解衣而養，永異之。
units.en: Ji's birth mother had long been ill; when Ji was eleven he would not unbind his clothes to nurse her—Yong marveled at this.
units.literal: Ji's birth mother had long been ill; when Ji was eleven he did not unbind his clothes to nurse her—Yong marveled at this.

units.zh: 性疏率，朗悟有才略，與族兄充、融、卷等俱知名，時稱之曰：「充融卷稷，是爲四張。」
units.en: By nature he was careless and open, bright with talent and stratagem; with his kinsmen Chong, Rong, and Juan he was all famed—the age called them, "Chong, Rong, Juan, and Ji—that is the Four Zhangs."
units.literal: By nature he was careless and open, bright and perceptive with talent and stratagem; with his kinsmen Chong, Rong, and Juan he was all famed—the age called them: "Chong, Rong, Juan, and Ji—that is the Four Zhangs."

units.zh: 齊永明中，爲剡縣令，略不視事，多爲山水遊。
units.en: In Qi's Yongming era he was Shan county magistrate, scarcely overseeing affairs, often roaming mountains and waters.
units.literal: In Qi's Yongming era he was Governor of Shan County, scarcely overseeing affairs, often roaming mountains and waters.

units.zh: 梁臺建，爲散騎常侍、中書令。
units.en: When the Liang court was set up he became cavalier attendant-in-ordinary and director of the secretariat.
units.literal: When the Liang regime was established he was made Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary and Director of the Secretariat.

units.zh: 會賊唐㝢之作亂，稷率厲縣人，保全縣境。
units.en: When the bandit Tang Yuzhi rebelled, Ji led and encouraged the county people and preserved the county territory.
units.literal: When the bandit Tang Yuzhi rebelled, Ji led and encouraged the county people and preserved the county territory.

units.zh: 尋徵還，爲持節、輔國將軍、都督北徐州諸軍事、北徐州刺史。
units.en: Soon recalled, he became bearer of credentials, General Who Assists the State, area commander of North Xuzhou, and North Xuzhou inspector.
units.literal: Soon he was recalled and made Bearer of Credentials, General Who Assists the State, Area Commander of all North Xuzhou military affairs, and North Xuzhou Inspector.

units.zh: 北徐州刺史王珍國就稷謀之，乃使直閤張齊害東昏于含德殿。
units.en: North Xuzhou inspector Wang Zhenguo plotted with Ji; Ji had Direct Attendant Zhang Qi kill Donghun in Hede Hall.
units.literal: North Xuzhou Inspector Wang Zhenguo consulted with Ji; Ji then had Direct Attendant Zhang Qi kill Donghun in Hede Hall.

units.zh: 又爲侍中、國子祭酒，領驍騎將軍，遷護軍將軍、揚州大中正，以事免。
units.en: He again became attendant within and chancellor of the National University, with concurrent rapid cavalry general; he became protector general and Yangzhou chief rectifier, then was dismissed over an affair.
units.literal: He was again made Attendant Within and Chancellor of the National University, with concurrent Rapid Cavalry General; he was transferred to Protector General and Yangzhou Chief Rectifier, then dismissed over an affair.

units.zh: 尋爲度支尚書、前將軍、太子右衛率，又以公事免。
units.en: Soon he became minister of revenue, front general, and right crown prince palace guard commander, then was again dismissed over official business.
units.literal: Soon he was made Minister of Revenue, Front General, and Right Crown Prince Palace Guard Commander, then again dismissed over an official matter.

units.zh: 州人徐道角等夜襲州城，害稷，時年六十三。
units.en: Provincial men Xu Daojiao and others attacked the seat by night and killed Ji, aged sixty-three.
units.literal: Provincial men Xu Daojiao and others night-attacked the provincial seat and killed Ji; he was sixty-three.

units.zh: 有司奏削爵土。
units.en: The responsible office memorialized to strip his fief and lands.
units.literal: The responsible office memorialized to strip his enfeoffment and lands.

units.zh: 稷兼衛尉，副王瑩都督城內諸軍事。
units.en: Ji held the concurrent guard commandancy and assisted Wang Ying in commanding the city's forces.
units.literal: Ji held the concurrent commandantship and assisted Wang Ying in commanding all military affairs within the city.

units.zh: 稷召尚書右僕射王亮等列坐殿前西鐘下，謂曰：「昔桀有昏德，鼎遷于殷；
units.en: Ji summoned Right Vice Director Wang Liang and others to sit before the western bell in the hall and said, "Of old Jie had dark virtue, and the tripod moved to Yin;
units.literal: Ji summoned Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Wang Liang and others to sit in a row before the western bell in the hall and said: "Of old Jie had dark virtue, and the tripod moved to Yin;

units.zh: 商紂暴虐，鼎遷于周。
units.en: Shang's Zhou was violent and cruel, and the tripod moved to Zhou.
units.literal: Shang's Zhou was violent and cruel, and the tripod moved to Zhou.

units.zh: 今獨夫自絕于天，四海已歸聖主，斯實微子去殷之時，項伯歸漢之日，可不勉哉！」
units.en: Now the tyrant has cut himself off from Heaven; the four seas already belong to the sage lord—this is Weizi leaving Yin, Xiang Bo returning to Han. You must exert yourselves!"
units.literal: Now the lone man has cut himself off from Heaven; the four seas already belong to the sage lord—this is truly the time of Weizi leaving Yin, Xiang Bo returning to Han. You must exert yourselves!"

units.zh: 稷性烈亮，善與人交。
units.en: Ji was fierce and bright, and good at friendship.
units.literal: Ji's nature was fierce and bright, and he was good at making friends.

units.zh: 歷官無蓄聚，俸祿皆頒之親故，家無餘財。
units.en: He never hoarded in office; he gave his salary to kin and friends, and his house held no surplus.
units.literal: In office he never accumulated wealth; his salary he always distributed to kin and friends, and his house had no surplus.

units.zh: 永元末，徵爲侍中，宿衛宮城。
units.en: At the end of Yongyuan he was summoned as attendant within and guarded the palace city.
units.literal: At the end of the Yongyuan era he was summoned as Attendant Within and guarded the palace city.

units.zh: 會魏軍退，仍出爲散騎常侍、將軍，吳興太守，秩中二千石。
units.en: When the Wei army withdrew he went out as cavalier attendant and general, Wuxing administrator, at salary rank two thousand dan.
units.literal: When the Wei army withdrew he went out as Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary and General, Wuxing Administrator, with salary rank at two thousand dan.

units.zh: 武陵王曅爲護軍，轉護軍司馬，尋爲本州治中。
units.en: When the prince of Wuling was guard general, Ji was transferred to guard general staff officer, soon made chief administrator of his native province.
units.literal: When Prince of Wuling Ye was Guard General, Ji was transferred to Guard General Staff Officer, soon made Chief Administrator of his native province.

units.zh: 明帝領牧，仍爲別駕。
units.en: When Emperor Ming held the governorship, Ji remained as vice governor.
units.literal: When Emperor Ming held the governorship, Ji remained as Vice Governor.

units.zh: 魏衆稱百萬，圍城累日，時經略處分，文季悉委稷焉。
units.en: Wei forces were said to number a million and besieged the city for many days; all planning and disposition Wenji wholly entrusted to Ji.
units.literal: Wei forces were said to number a million and besieged the city for many days; all planning and disposition Wenji wholly entrusted to Ji.

units.zh: 時雍州刺史曹虎度樊城岸，以稷知州事。
units.en: At the time Cao Hu, Inspector of Yong Province, crossed to the Fancheng bank, and Ji was put in charge of provincial affairs.
units.literal: At the time Cao Hu, Inspector of Yong Province, crossed to the Fancheng bank, and Ji was made acting administrator of the province.

units.zh: 魏師退，稷還荊州，就拜黃門侍郎，復爲司馬、新興、永寧二郡太守。
units.en: When Wei forces withdrew, Ji returned to Jing province and was at once appointed yellow gate gentleman, again made staff officer and governor of Xinxing and Yongning.
units.literal: When Wei forces withdrew, Ji returned to Jing Province and was at once appointed Yellow Gate Gentleman, again made Staff Officer and Governor of both Xinxing and Yongning commanderies.

units.zh: 乃遣國子博士范雲、舍人裴長穆等使石頭城詣高祖，高祖以稷爲侍中、左衛將軍。
units.en: Then he sent National University erudite Fan Yun, attendant Pei Changmu, and others to Stone City to see Gaozu; Gaozu made Ji attendant within and left palace guard general.
units.literal: Then he sent National University Erudite Fan Yun, Attendant Pei Changmu, and others to Stone City to present themselves to Gaozu; Gaozu made Ji Attendant Within and Left Palace Guard General.

units.zh: 高祖總百揆，遷大司馬左司馬。
units.en: When Gaozu took charge of all affairs, Ji became the grand marshal's left staff officer.
units.literal: When Gaozu oversaw all state affairs, Ji was transferred to Left Staff Officer of the Grand Marshal.

units.zh: 輿駕將欲如稷宅，以盛暑，留幸僕射省，舊臨幸供具皆酬太官饌直，帝以稷清貧，手詔不受。
units.en: The emperor was about to visit Ji's house; in the intense heat he stayed at the vice director's office instead. Old custom reimbursed visit supplies from the Grand Provisioner; because Ji was poor, the emperor personally issued an edict that he accept nothing.
units.literal: The imperial carriage was about to visit Ji's house; because of the intense heat the Emperor stayed instead at the Vice Director's office. By old custom items for an imperial visit were reimbursed from the Grand Provisioner's feast allowance; because Ji was pure and poor, the Emperor personally issued an edict that he should not accept them.

units.zh: 會魏寇朐山，詔稷權頓六里，都督衆軍。
units.en: When Wei invaded Qushan, Ji was ordered to hold Liuli temporarily and command all armies.
units.literal: When Wei invaded Qushan, an edict ordered Ji to station temporarily at Liuli and command all armies.

units.zh: 且稷寬弛無防，僚吏頗侵漁之。
units.en: moreover Ji was lax and undefended, and his staff often preyed on the province.
units.literal: moreover Ji was lax and undefended, and his staff often encroached and fleeced.

units.zh: 初去吳興郡，以僕射徵，道由吳鄉，候稷者滿水陸。
units.en: When he first left Wuxing and was summoned as vice director, his route passed Wu country; those waiting for Ji filled land and water.
units.literal: When he first left Wuxing commandery and was summoned as Vice Director, his route passed his Wu homeland; those waiting to see Ji filled the waterways and roads.

units.zh: 稷單裝徑還京師，人莫之識，其率素如此。
units.en: Ji returned to the capital alone with plain baggage; no one knew him—such was his austerity.
units.literal: Ji returned to the capital alone with simple baggage; no one recognized him—such was his plain simplicity.

units.zh: 稷長女楚瑗，適會稽孔氏，無子歸宗。
units.en: Ji's eldest daughter Chu Yuan married the Kong clan of Kuaiji; childless, she returned to her clan.
units.literal: Ji's eldest daughter Chu Yuan married into the Kong clan of Kuaiji; having no son, she returned to her clan.

units.zh: 至稷見害，女以身蔽刃，先父卒。
units.en: When Ji was killed, his daughter shielded him with her body and died before her father.
units.literal: When Ji was killed, his daughter used her body to shield the blade and died before her father.

units.zh: 稷子嵊，別有傳。
units.en: Ji's son Song has a separate biography.
units.literal: Ji's son Song has a separate biography.

units.zh: 卷字令遠，稷從兄也。
units.en: Juan, styled Lingyuan, was Ji's cousin.
units.literal: Juan, styled Lingyuan, was Ji's cousin.

units.zh: 與懷朔省事雲中司馬子如及秀容人劉貴、中山人賈顯智為奔走之友，懷朔戶曹史孫騰、外兵史侯景亦相友結。
units.en: He made running companions of Sima Ziru, affairs clerk at Huaishuo's Yunzhong desk, Liu Gui of Xiurong, and Jia Xianzhi of Zhongshan; Sun Teng, the garrison household clerk, and Hou Jing, clerk for external military affairs, joined their circle as well.
units.literal: With Sima Ziru, affairs clerk of Yunzhong at Huaishuo, Liu Gui of Xiurong, and Jia Xianzhi of Zhongshan he formed a band of comrades ready to run errands; Sun Teng, household clerk at Huaishuo, and Hou Jing, clerk in external military affairs, also joined in friendship.

units.zh: 太宗簡文皇帝諱綱，字世纘，小字六通，高祖第三子，昭明太子母弟也。
units.en: Taizong Emperor Jianwen, personal name Gang, courtesy name Shizuan, childhood name Liutong, was Gaozu's third son and Zhaoming Crown Prince's younger brother by the same mother.
units.literal: The Taizong Emperor Jianwen was tabooed Gang, style name Shizuan, childhood name Liutong; he was the third son of the Gaozu and a uterine younger brother of Crown Prince Zhaoming.

units.zh: 初，太宗見幽縶，題壁自序云：「有梁正士蘭陵蕭世纘，立身行道，終始如一，風雨如晦，雞鳴不已。
units.en: At first, when Taizong was held captive, he wrote on the wall: "I, Xiao Shizuan of Lanling, upright man of Liang, one in conduct from start to finish—though wind and rain darken the sky, the cock crows without cease.
units.literal: At first, when Taizong was imprisoned, he wrote a self-account on the wall, saying: "I, Xiao Shizuan of Lanling, upright man of Liang, in conduct from first to last one—though wind and rain darken the sky, the cock crows without cease.

units.zh: 晉安王綱，文義生知，孝敬自然，威惠外宣，德行內敏，羣后歸美，率土宅心。
units.en: Prince Gang of Jin'an was gifted in letters and principles, naturally filial and respectful, his authority and kindness known abroad and his virtue keen within; the lords praised him and the realm took him to heart.
units.literal: Prince of Jin'an Gang, gifted in letters and right by nature, filial and respectful by instinct, his authority and kindness proclaimed abroad and virtue and conduct keen within, the feudal lords admired him and all the land took him to heart.

units.zh: 明年，三月己丑，王僧辯率前百官奉梓宮升朝堂，世祖追崇為簡文皇帝，廟曰太宗。
units.en: The next year, on jichou in the third month, Wang Senbian led the former hundred officials to raise the coffin to the audience hall; Shizu posthumously honored him as Emperor Jianwen with temple name Taizong.
units.literal: The next year, third month, day jichou, Wang Senbian led the former hundred officials in escorting the coffin up the audience hall; Shizu posthumously honored him as Emperor Jianwen, with temple name Taizong.

units.zh: 五年，封晉安王，食邑八千戶。
units.en: In year 5 he was made Prince of Jin'an with a fief of eight thousand households.
units.literal: In year 5 he was enfeoffed as Prince of Jin'an with a fief of eight thousand households.

units.zh: 戊午，侯景遣衛尉卿彭俊、廂公王僧貴率兵入殿，廢太宗為晉安王，幽于永福省。
units.en: On wuwu day Hou Jing sent minister of the guard Peng Jun and palace section commander Wang Senggui with troops into the hall, deposed Taizong as Prince of Jin'an, and imprisoned him in Yongfu Palace.
units.literal: On wuwu, Hou Jing sent Minister of the Guard Peng Jun and Palace Section Commander Wang Senggui to lead troops into the hall, deposed Taizong as Prince of Jin'an, and confined him in Yongfu Palace.

units.zh: 可立為皇太子。」
units.en: He is to be established as crown prince."
units.literal: He may be established as crown prince."

units.zh: 賊偽諡曰明皇帝，廟稱高宗。
units.en: The rebels gave him the posthumous title Bright Emperor and the temple name Gaozong.
units.literal: The rebels gave the posthumous title Bright Emperor and the temple name Gaozong.

units.zh: 辛巳，卽皇帝位。
units.en: On xinsi he took the throne.
units.literal: On xinsi he ascended the imperial throne.

units.zh: 雅好題詩，其序云：「余七歲有詩癖，長而不倦。」
units.en: He loved poetry by nature; in his preface he wrote, "At seven I had a poetry mania, and as I grew I never tired of it."
units.literal: He loved composing poetry by nature; in his preface he wrote: "At seven I had a poetry mania, and in growing up I never tired of it."

units.zh: 然傷於輕豔，當時號曰「宮體」。
units.en: Yet he was faulted for frivolous ornament, and his age called it the "Palace Style."
units.literal: Yet he was faulted for frivolous ornament, and his age styled this the "Palace Style."

units.zh: 所著《昭明太子傳》五卷，《諸王傳》三十卷，《禮大義》二十卷，《老子義》二十卷，《莊子義》二十卷，《長春義記》一百卷，《法寶連璧》三百卷，並行於世焉。
units.en: His works included Biography of the Heir Apparent Zhaoming in five scrolls, Biographies of the Princes in thirty scrolls, Great Meaning of the Rites in twenty scrolls, Meaning of the Laozi in twenty scrolls, Meaning of the Zhuangzi in twenty scrolls, Recorded Meaning of Eternal Spring in one hundred scrolls, and Treasured Laws Linked Pearls in three hundred scrolls—all circulated in his day.
units.literal: His works included Biography of the Heir Apparent Zhaoming in five scrolls, Biographies of the Princes in thirty scrolls, Great Meaning of the Rites in twenty scrolls, Meaning of the Laozi in twenty scrolls, Meaning of the Zhuangzi in twenty scrolls, Recorded Meaning of Eternal Spring in one hundred scrolls, and Treasured Laws Linked Pearls in three hundred scrolls—all circulated in his time.

units.zh: 博綜儒書，善言玄理。
units.en: He mastered Confucian classics and was skilled in Neo-Daoist discourse.
units.literal: Broadly versed in Confucian books, skilled in discoursing on Dark Learning.

units.zh: 高祖所制《五經講疏》，嘗於玄圃奉述，聽者傾朝野。
units.en: When Gaozu composed his Expositions on the Five Classics, Taizong once lectured on them at the Dark Garden; listeners filled court and countryside.
units.literal: When Gaozu composed Expositions on the Five Classics, Taizong once presented them at the Dark Garden; listeners filled court and countryside.

units.zh: 是歲，丁所生穆貴嬪喪，上表陳解，詔還攝本任。
units.en: That year, when his birth mother Honored Consort Mu died, he asked to resign but was ordered back to his post.
units.literal: That year, on mourning for his birth mother Honored Consort Mu, he submitted a memorial requesting release; an edict ordered him to resume his original duties.

units.zh: 天監二年十月丁未，生於顯陽殿。
units.en: On dingwei in the tenth month of Tianjian 2 he was born in Xianyang Hall.
units.literal: In the tenth month, day dingwei, year 2 of Tianjian, he was born in Xianyang Hall.

units.zh: 旣醉寢，王偉、彭儁進土囊，王修纂坐其上，於是太宗崩於永福省，時年四十九。
units.en: When he was drunk and asleep, Wang Wei and Peng Jun brought in a bag of earth; Wang Xiuzuan sat on it—and Taizong died in Yongfu Palace at the age of forty-nine.
units.literal: When he was drunk and asleep, Wang Wei and Peng Jun brought in a bag of earth; Wang Xiuzuan sat upon it—and thereupon Taizong died in Yongfu Palace, aged forty-nine.

units.zh: 太清三年五月丙辰，高祖崩。
units.en: On bingchen in the fifth month of Taiqing 3 Gaozu died.
units.literal: In the fifth month, day bingchen, year 3 of Taiqing, the Gaozu died.

units.zh: 八年，為雲麾將軍，領石頭戍軍事，量置佐吏。
units.en: In year 8 he became General of the Cloud Banner, took charge of Shitou garrison affairs, and had aides appointed as required.
units.literal: In year 8 he was made General of the Cloud Banner, supervising military affairs at the Shitou garrison, with assistant officials appointed as needed.

units.zh: 九年，遷使持節、都督南北兗青徐冀五州諸軍事、宣毅將軍、南兗州刺史。
units.en: In year 9 he was made Bearer of the Staff and commander of the five Yan, Qing, Xu, and Ji provinces, General Who Proclaims Resolution, and South Yanzhou inspector.
units.literal: In year 9 he was transferred to Bearer of the Staff, Commander over military affairs in the five provinces North and South Yan, Qing, Xu, and Ji, made General Who Proclaims Resolution and South Yanzhou Inspector.

units.zh: 十二年，入為宣惠將軍、丹陽尹。
units.en: In year 12 he entered court as General Who Proclaims Grace and intendant of Danyang.
units.literal: In year 12 he entered the capital as General Who Proclaims Grace and Intendant of Danyang.

units.zh: 十三年，出為使持節、都督荊雍梁南北秦益寧七州諸軍事、南蠻校尉、荊州刺史，將軍如故。
units.en: In year 13 he went out as Bearer of the Staff, commander of Jing, Yong, Liang, the two Qin, Yi, and Ning, Colonel of the Southern Barbarians, and Jingzhou inspector, retaining his generalship.
units.literal: In year 13 he went out as Bearer of the Staff, Commander over military affairs in the seven provinces Jing, Yong, Liang, North and South Qin, Yi, and Ning, made Colonel of the Southern Barbarians and Jingzhou Inspector, his generalship unchanged.

units.zh: 十四年，徙為都督江州諸軍事、雲麾將軍、江州刺史，持節如故。
units.en: In year 14 he was reassigned commander of Jiangzhou, General of the Cloud Banner, and Jiangzhou inspector, still Bearer of the Staff.
units.literal: In year 14 he was reassigned as Commander over military affairs in Jiangzhou, General of the Cloud Banner and Jiangzhou Inspector, Bearer of the Staff unchanged.

units.zh: 十七年，徵為西中郎將、領石頭戍軍事，尋復為宣惠將軍、丹陽尹，加侍中。
units.en: In year 17 he was recalled as Leader of the Palace Gentlemen of the West with Shitou garrison duties, then again General Who Proclaims Grace and Danyang intendant, with Palace Attendant added.
units.literal: In year 17 he was summoned as Leader of the Palace Gentlemen of the West, supervising the Shitou garrison; soon restored as General Who Proclaims Grace and Intendant of Danyang, additionally made Palace Attendant.

units.zh: 未拜，改授雲麾將軍、南徐州刺史。
units.en: before taking office he was reassigned General of the Cloud Banner and South Xuzhou inspector.
units.literal: before assuming the post, he was reassigned as General of the Cloud Banner and South Xuzhou Inspector.

units.zh: 四年，徙為使持節、都督雍梁、南北秦四州郢州之竟陵司州之隨郡諸軍事，平西將軍、寧蠻校尉、雍州刺史。
units.en: In year 4 he was reassigned Bearer of the Staff, commander of Yong, Liang, the two Qin, and related districts, General Who Pacifies the West, Colonel of Pacified Barbarians, and Yongzhou inspector.
units.literal: In year 4 he was reassigned as Bearer of the Staff, Commander over military affairs in Yong and Liang, North and South Qin, the four provinces, Jingzhou's Jingling, and Sizhou's Su commandery, made General Who Pacifies the West, Colonel of Pacified Barbarians, and Yongzhou Inspector.

units.zh: 五年，進號安北將軍。
units.en: In year 5 he was promoted to General Who Pacifies the North.
units.literal: In year 5 he was advanced to General Who Pacifies the North.

units.zh: 二年，徵為都督南揚、徐二州諸軍事、驃騎將軍、揚州刺史。
units.en: In year 2 he was recalled as commander of South Yang and Xu, General of Agile Cavalry, and Yangzhou inspector.
units.literal: In year 2 he was summoned as Commander over military affairs in South Yang and Xu, made General of Agile Cavalry and Yangzhou Inspector.

units.zh: 七月乙亥，臨軒策拜，以脩繕東宮，權居東府。
units.en: On yihai in the seventh month he was invested at the throne hall; while the Eastern Palace was repaired he lodged temporarily at the Eastern Mansion.
units.literal: On yihai in the seventh month, the enthronement ceremony was held at the imperial hall; because the Eastern Palace was under repair, he temporarily resided at the Eastern Mansion.

units.zh: 普通元年，出為使持節、都督益寧雍梁南北秦沙七州諸軍事、益州刺史；
units.en: In Putong 1 he went out as Bearer of the Staff, commander of Yi, Ning, Yong, Liang, the two Qin, and Sha, and Yi province inspector;
units.literal: In year 1 of Putong he went out as Bearer of the Staff, Commander over military affairs in the seven provinces Yi, Ning, Yong, Liang, North and South Qin, and Sha, and made Yi Province Inspector;

units.zh: 三年四月乙巳，昭明太子薨。
units.en: On yisi in the fourth month of year 3 Crown Prince Zhaoming died.
units.literal: In the fourth month, day yisi, year 3, Crown Prince Zhaoming died.

units.zh: 大寶元年春正月辛亥朔，以國哀不朝會。
units.en: On xinhai, the new-year's day of Dabao 1, national mourning prevented the court assembly.
units.literal: On xinhai, the first day of the first month of spring in year 1 of Dabao, because of national mourning there was no court assembly.

units.zh: 可大赦天下，改太清四年為大寶元年。」
units.en: A general amnesty is proclaimed and Taiqing 4 is changed to Dabao 1."
units.literal: A general amnesty may be proclaimed; Taiqing year 4 is changed to Dabao year 1."

units.zh: 詔曰：「朕以不造，夙丁閔凶。
units.en: An edict said, "Ill-fated as I am, I have long borne this grief.
units.literal: An edict said: "Our lack of fortune afflicts us; from early we suffered this calamity.

units.zh: 大行皇帝奄棄萬國，攀慕號躃，厝身靡所。
units.en: The late emperor has suddenly left the myriad realms; in longing and wailing I have nowhere to set myself.
units.literal: The late emperor suddenly abandoned the myriad realms; we cling and wail and have nowhere to place ourselves.

units.zh: 猥以寡德，越居民上，煢煢在疚，罔知所託，方賴籓輔，社稷用安。
units.en: With slight virtue I have undeservedly risen above the people; alone in grief I know not whom to trust, and must rely on the feudatories to keep the altars secure.
units.literal: Unworthily with slight virtue we have crossed above the people; alone in anguish we know not where to lean, yet rely on the feudal helpers that the altars may be secure.

units.zh: 謹遵先旨，顧命遺澤，宜加億兆。
units.en: Respectfully following the prior command and the grace of the deathbed charge, the hundred millions should receive added benefit.
